create_RecurrentAgent: create a RecurrentAgent instance with a model and number of actions for recurrent policy execution
call_RecurrentAgent_step: call the RecurrentAgent to execute one step and return action probabilities and new state
update_RecurrentAgent_model: update the RecurrentAgent model weights by loading a new state dictionary
build_AgentModel: build an AgentModel neural network that computes action scores from observations and hidden state
build_BaselineModel: build a BaselineModel neural network that computes state value V(s) for the critic
